title: Sales Manager
job_description: Responsible for managing sales and client relationships. The Sales Manager will develop and implement sales strategies, identify new business opportunities, and maintain relationships with key clients. This role requires a deep understanding of market trends, excellent negotiation skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with other departments to achieve company goals. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in sales, strong leadership abilities, and a passion for driving business growth.
requirements: Minimum of 5 years of experience in sales, preferably in a managerial role.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with clients.
Strong leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to motivate and guide a sales team.
In-depth knowledge of market trends and the ability to develop effective sales strategies.
Excellent negotiation skills and the ability to close deals effectively.
Ability to work collaboratively with other departments to achieve company goals.

title: Logistics Coordinator
job_description: Coordinate logistics and supply chain operations. The Logistics Coordinator will oversee the entire supply chain process, from procurement to delivery. The ideal candidate will have experience in logistics, excellent problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to maintaining high standards of efficiency and accuracy.
requirements: Minimum of 3 years of experience in logistics or supply chain management.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and work under pressure.
Experience in managing inventory levels and coordinating with suppliers and transporters.
Excellent problem-solving abilities and a commitment to maintaining high standards of efficiency and accuracy.

The ideal candidate will have experience in railway operations, excellent problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to safety and efficiency.
requirements: Minimum of 5 years of experience in railway operations.
Strong leadership skills and the ability to manage a team effectively.
Deep understanding of railway operations and transportation regulations.
Excellent problem-solving abilities and the ability to make quick decisions in a fast-paced environment.
Commitment to safety and efficiency in railway operations.
